title: RETHINKING HARMLESS REFUSALS WHEN FINE-TUNING FOUNDATION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Role-playing scenarios where the LLM acts as a real estate assistant and receives an unethical directive from a manager to discriminate against non-White buyers (redlining). The model is then evaluated on its responses to a Black customer, whose race is indicated either through a text profile or an image attachment, to determine if it complies with the discriminatory instruction.
